description: Lists the ad leads who went quiet after their first reply and wait for the business to write to them, oldest first: each with its chat, the product the first reply showed, when the follow-up was given, whether WhatsApp’s window to write freely is open, and what one tap sends (the saved reply while the window is open, else the marketing template). A follow-up leaves the list once it is sent or the customer writes again. Read-only.
name: list_follow_ups
title: See today’s follow-ups
